selected_installer.name: skills
reasons: supports Codex, Claude Code, Hermes Agent, and many additional agents
supports local, GitHub, GitLab, and git sources
supports non-interactive copy installation for CI and managed deployment
provides list, find, update, remove, init, and temporary-use commands

alternatives.name: Codex skill-installer
alternatives.reason: official and automatically available in current Codex releases, but Codex-specific

alternatives.name: OpenSkills
alternatives.reason: strong universal SKILL.md loader, but the selected CLI has broader current agent targeting and native .agents/skills discovery

alternatives.name: gh skill install
alternatives.reason: useful when GitHub CLI is already the managed distribution channel

alternatives.name: ags
alternatives.reason: large searchable catalog and SHA tracking require a separate trust and registry review

hard_invariants: Do not use latest or another floating npm version.
Do not install an unregistered local skill.
Validate the canonical library before installation.
Default to copy mode for global installation.
Do not overwrite credentials or unrelated agent configuration.
Do not claim installation succeeded without command output or filesystem evidence.
Updates require explicit review of the new package version and upstream commit.
